Power your high-speed network with the OTECH LC-LC OM3 Duplex Multimode Fiber Patch Cable. This 10-meter (32.8ft) cable is engineered for peak performance in demanding environments like data centers, server rooms, and enterprise networks. Featuring LC duplex connectors on both ends, it guarantees seamless connectivity and supports 10Gb/s data transfer rates. The aqua jacket provides quick OM3 identification, while the precision-designed connectors ensure minimal signal loss for reliable data transmission.


Key Features:

High-Speed Performance: Ideal for 10Gb/s applications over OM3 multimode fiber, delivering exceptional bandwidth.

Robust Construction: Flexible, riser-rated jacket with reinforced LC connectors and strain relief boots for durability.

Easy Identification: Aqua color-coding simplifies OM3 recognition and streamlines cable management.

Broad Compatibility: Connects effortlessly with switches, routers, servers, and storage devices.

Low Signal Loss: Precision-polished connectors maintain insertion loss below 0.3dB for consistent performance.

Perfect For: Data centers, enterprise networks, server farms, SAN/NAS setups, and telecommunications infrastructure.

Specifications:

  • Connector: LC-LC Duplex
  • Cable Type: OM3 Multimode (50/125µm)
  • Length: 10 Meters (32.8ft)
  • Jacket Color: Aqua
  • Insertion Loss: ≤0.3dB
